tool_args.rationale: The five paid observations establish a monotone-concave response in u_now, but do not distinguish competing smooth mechanisms with confidence sufficient for the 0.045 confirmation tolerance. A low-cost open-branch observation offers the most useful contrast.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All measurements hold x_now, mem_conv, s_grad, and H essentially fixed, and cover only one u_now trajectory; this leaves plausible saturating versus inhibitory or power-law mechanisms ambiguous, especially under the wide-escape setting.
More points along the same monotone-concave trajectory are less discriminating than opening a distinct branch.
Observed s_grad is near 1, well below the source note's threshold near 2.5; this probe is not relevant to the sampled regime.
It is explicitly nuisance information and cannot resolve the target-law ambiguity.
